conclusion: Independent original-source reads confirm CG000674/CG000477 guide order, CG000621 custom physical probe architecture, and the official human v1.0.1 WTA reference CSV. The CSV resolves 50-nt target-region sequences for this kit version; it does not establish the physical commercial LHS/RHS ordering oligos, their modifications, or an experiment-specific target subset. Independent reads also covered the linked CG000528 planner, CG000478 fixation, CG000529 antibody labeling, CG000396 instrument and CG000479 clogging documents; the latter two were excluded only from missing molecular-oligo claims with reasons. CG000529 adds a source-backed protein branch with /5AmMC12/ TotalSeq-C oligo and Nextera Read 2; the AB attachment transition remains unresolved and warned. No remaining missing-information claim is accepted.
